### The World Upside Down
Author: Burk Parsons
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/world-upside-down
Passage: Acts 17:6
Points:
- Christians across diverse cultures share striking unity in doctrine, practice, and worship.
- Believers around the globe are united by the same Scriptures, the same Spirit, and one Lord.
- Gathering for worship unites local believers with the worldwide church awaiting Christ's return.
- The widespread testimony of the global church shows how the gospel has turned the world upside down.

### His Only Priority
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-may-5-6-2012.html
Passage: Acts 17:1-9
Points:
- Paul modeled transparent and accessible ministry rather than staying aloof or secretive.
- Authentic spiritual leaders live open, honest lives with nothing to conceal.
- Physical suffering and fierce opposition in ministry did not stop Paul from persevering.
- Paul maintained a single enduring priority through trials: proclaiming Christ and the cross.
